title: 第6章 太顺利了-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一阵天旋地转之后，吴姜的阴魂，凭空出现在了一片空旷的土地上。

    他快速环视了一下四周，很快就认出了，这里是苍名县城通往下面历阳镇的公路，此刻，不时有的还有车辆呼啸而过。

    吴姜沿着公路飘了一段距离，很快就感知到了前方有一团浓郁的阴气，目光瞬间锁定了不远处路边的身影。

    那是一道半透明的虚影，身形直直的站在那里，身上还穿着一件超市的工作服，头发凌乱地贴在额前，一直低着头，周身萦绕着淡淡的阴气，只是那阴气隐约有凝聚加重的趋势，显然是怨念还在慢慢滋生。

    吴姜心里猛地一紧，下意识握紧了手中的斩魂剑，手心瞬间冒出了冷汗——这可是他第一次直面真正的游魂，哪怕早就摸清了鬼物常识，难免还是会紧张。

    他回忆了一下脑海中的任务信息，又看了一下前方的虚影，立刻对上了号。

    游魂信息：姓名：张亚芳，女，38岁，苍名县历阳镇张家村人，2025年9月05日23时，骑行电动车途中被路过车辆意外撞倒，当场重伤；肇事司机肇事逃逸，致其失血过多身亡，因心存不甘与怨念，滞留人间化为游魂。

    吴姜深吸一口气，用力定了定神，暗自给自己壮胆，挺直腰板，朝着张亚芳的方向飘了过去。

    可还没等他酝酿好语气、开口亮明身份，那道虚影便猛地抬起头，正好对上了他的目光。

    看清张亚芳的模样，吴姜还是忍不住心头一缩，下意识顿住了脚步——太惨了！她脸上、身上还沾着未干的血污，额头有一道狰狞的伤口，衣服被划破多处，浑身散发着淡淡的血腥味，眼神里满是痛苦与茫然，看得人心里发沉。

    吴姜立刻提高警惕，一手紧紧攥着腰间的勾魂锁链，另一手搭在斩魂剑的剑柄上，老祖宗赐下的符箓，也放在了随手就能掏出的位置。

    他正犹豫着，是先摆好阴差的架子说句场面话，还是直接动手锁魂，免得夜长梦多。

    可下一秒，令人意想不到的一幕发生了。

    那满身血污的女鬼先是愣了一下，目光落在他身上的玄黑色鬼差制服、腰间的勾魂锁链，还有手中的斩魂剑上时，浑身剧烈一颤，直接跪了。

    “鬼差大人冤枉啊！那天杀的司机撞了我之后，要是及时把我送进医院，我也不会死，可他居然直接跑了，害得我流血过多咽了气！到现在，那个肇事司机还没找到，我家里还有两个年幼的孩子，他们小小年纪就没了妈妈，求鬼差大人为我做主啊！”

    吴姜彻底愣住了，脸上写满了错愕。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After a while, Wu Jiang’s ghost appeared in an empty land out of thin air.

He quickly looked around and quickly recognized that this was the highway from Cangming County to Liyang Town below. At this moment, there were vehicles whizzing by from time to time.

Wu Jiang drifted along the road for a while, and soon felt a strong cloud of Yin Qi in front of him, and his eyes instantly locked on the figure on the roadside not far away.

It was a translucent shadow, standing there upright, still wearing a supermarket work clothes, with messy hair stuck to his forehead, with his head lowered, and there was a faint yin energy lingering around him, but the yin energy had a tendency to condense and increase in intensity. It was obvious that resentment was still slowly growing.

Wu Jiang’s heart suddenly tightened, and he subconsciously clenched the soul-slaying sword in his hand, and cold sweat broke out in his palms - this was the first time he faced a real wandering soul, and even if he had already understood the common sense about ghosts, he would still be nervous.

He recalled the mission information in his mind, looked at the shadow in front of him, and immediately locked the number.

Wandering ghost information: Name: Zhang Yafang, female, 38 years old, from Zhangjia Village, Liyang Town, Cangming County. At 23:00 on September 5, 2025, she was accidentally hit by a passing vehicle while riding an electric bicycle and was seriously injured on the spot; the driver hit and run, causing him to die of excessive blood loss. Because of his unwillingness and resentment, he stayed in the world and became a wandering ghost.

Wu Jiang took a deep breath, calmed himself down, secretly emboldened himself, straightened his back, and floated in the direction of Zhang Yafang.

But before he could prepare his tone and reveal his identity, the shadow suddenly raised its head and met his gaze.

Seeing Zhang Yafang’s appearance clearly, Wu Jiang couldn’t help but feel his heart shrink, and subconsciously stopped in his tracks - it was so miserable!Her face and body were still stained with fresh blood, and there was a hideous wound on her forehead. Her clothes were torn in many places, and she exuded a faint smell of blood. Her eyes were full of pain and confusion, which made people feel heavy.

Wu Jiang immediately increased his vigilance, holding the soul-enchanting chain around his waist with one hand, and placing the other hand on the hilt of the soul-cutting sword. The talisman given by his ancestor was also placed in a position where he could easily take it out.

He was hesitating whether to put on a shady air and make some excuses first, or to lock the soul directly to avoid a long night and many dreams.

But the next second, an unexpected scene happened.

The female ghost covered in blood was stunned for a moment. When her eyes fell on the black ghost uniform on his body, the soul seducing chain around his waist, and the soul-slaying sword in his hand, she trembled violently and knelt down.

"Master Guizha is unjust! After that killer driver hit me, if I had been sent to the hospital in time, I would not have died, but he actually ran away, causing me to bleed too much and die! Until now, the driver who caused the accident has not been found. I still have two young children at home. They lost their mother at a young age. Please Lord Guizha, please make the decision for me!"

Wu Jiang was completely stunned, with astonishment written all over his face.

title_en: Chapter 6 It went so smoothly - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"
